title: Validation failures return 422, spec example cites 400
evidence: Sources/BookAPI/Router.swift:75 returns .error(422, ...) for missing title/author; REQUIREMENTS.json R9 how_to_verify says 'rejected (400)'. Malformed non-object bodies do return 400 (Router.swift:73). 422 is a defensible choice for field-validation errors, so R9 ('title and author required') is satisfied.
suggestion: Optional: return 400 for validation errors to match the spec's example status code exactly, or leave as-is (422 is appropriate).

title: Robustness beyond spec: bound SQL params, body-size limits, thread safety
evidence: BookStore.swift uses parameterized queries (tested testSQLMetacharactersAreStoredVerbatim:139); HTTP.swift:23 enforces maxBodySize=1MB returning 413; BookStore.swift:12 guards access with NSLock; Router emits Location and Allow headers.
suggestion: None — noted as strengths, not deductions.
